The tension reaches its peak in Episode 5 of Paiso Ki Pathshaala! Teams face sharper financial questions, faster-paced rounds, and challenging money tasks that test both logic and instinct. Every move matters, and the margin for error is razor-thin.
Watch as Team Money Lords step up, play smart, and claim the win in a thrilling display of strategy, skill, and quick thinking. Learn from every decision, see how top teams manage pressure, and discover practical finance lessons you can apply in real life.
